questions.answer: stomack → stomach; kemist → chemist; corus → chorus; skeme → scheme; akhe → ache
questions.text: Tom had a stomack ache after lunch, so his mum took him to the kemist. The kind lady gave him some medicine and told him to rest. Later he felt better and joined the corus at school. His teacher had a new skeme to help the choir sing well, and they practised until the akhe in his tummy was forgotten.
